description: `!`-prefix on a source pattern with a `:name` fragment falls through to minimatch in the reference's `sourceMatches` (`serve-handler/src/index.js:38-67`): pathToRegExp's first-pass on `!/old-docs/:id` builds a regex that wants `!` as a literal, which real requests don't carry, so it returns null and minimatch handles the negation. Minimatch treats `:id` as literal characters, so the rule fires for every path that does NOT literally equal `/old-docs/:id`. Closes Codex round 2 P1: irserve previously rejected this combination at compile time via `CompileError::NegatedParam`.
